paragraphs.text: Full-time position. You must have held a clean driving licence for at least two years. Early starts from 5 am. A company van is provided, and wages are paid weekly.
Part-time, three days a week. Previous experience on reception is preferred, but full training will be given. A friendly manner is essential. Staff receive free dental treatment.
A temporary contract for our busy period from October to January. Evening and night shifts, with a higher rate of pay after 10 pm. No experience needed. Please apply online by 30 September.
Full-time. A recognised childcare qualification is required. We will pay for staff to complete further training. Working hours are 8 am to 6 pm on a rota.

Weekend work, Saturday and Sunday. You will manage a small team and be responsible for cashing up at the end of the day. A share of tips is paid monthly. Applicants must be available to start in early November.

items.prompt: is only for a limited period
offers a benefit linked to what the employer does
involves being in charge of other staff
asks for a certain amount of driving experience

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the five job advertisements, A–E. Which advertisement mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–E.
